State Owned Enterprises Committee
Agenda

Meeting: 11th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 10
Date: 27 October 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: 11:00 in the morning

1. Review of the matter submitted requesting a study of matters relating to the ownership, financing and management of "Maldives Port Development Private Limited", established jointly by three state-owned companies.

2. Review of the matter submitted requesting that the issue be looked into, as the people are facing many hardships because the RTL ferry service in B. Atoll is not being provided adequately.

3. Other matters.
